citation: Deru LS, Chamberlain CJ, Lance GR, et al. The Effects of Exercise on Appetite-Regulating Hormone Concentrations over a 36-h Fast in Healthy Young Adults: A Randomized Crossover Study. Nutrients. 2023.
protocol: 36 h fast, cross-over with or without an exercise bout at the start of the fast; samples at 0, 12, 24, 36 h
note: Hormones in pg/mL by multiplex (insulin reported in pg/mL, not uU/mL; GLP-1 pg/mL, likely total). Exercise bout (about 50 min, intensity per Methods) is the manipulated arm; the no-exercise arm is the plain 36 h fast. No glucose or FFA reported.
